enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running to stay cool through the warm night
enriched_activities.desc: Turn the fan switch to the on position. Set the fan to medium speed. Lie down on the bed on the back. Pull the sheet up to the chest. Close eyes. Turn the head to the left side. Turn the body onto the right side. Pull the pillow under the head. Stretch the right arm out to the side. Pull the sheet down to the waist. Turn the body onto the left side. Bend the knees. Remain lying on the bed without moving. Turn the head to the right side. Pull the pillow down. Remain lying on the bed without moving until the alarm sounds.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on the bed. Swing the legs over the edge of the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Reach the hand to the wall and press the light switch on. Stand in front of the sink. Turn the tap handle to open the water. Cup both hands under the water. Bring the water up to the face. Rub the face with both hands. Turn the tap handle to close the water. Pick up the towel from the rack. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the rack. Pick up the toothbrush from the holder. Turn the tap on. Wet the toothbrush under the water. Turn the tap off. Open the toothpaste cap. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Close the cap. Place the toothbrush in the mouth. Brush the teeth up and down. Spit into the sink. Turn the tap on. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Turn the tap off. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Pick up the clothes from the stool. Pull the shirt over the head. Pull the arms through the sleeves. Pull the trousers on one leg at a time. Fasten the waistband. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast (toast and tea), drinking a large glass of water
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the kitchen. Press the light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take the bread bag out of the refrigerator. Close the refrigerator door. Place the bread bag on the counter. Open the bag clip. Take two slices of bread out of the bag. Close the bag clip. Put the bread slices into the toaster slots. Press the toaster lever down. Take a plate out of the cupboard. Place the plate on the counter. Open the cupboard and take a cup out. Place the cup on the counter. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take the milk carton out. Close the refrigerator door. Wait for the toast to pop up. Pull the toast slices out of the toaster. Place the toast on the plate. Pour tea leaves into the cup. Pour hot water from the kettle into the cup. Pour milk into the cup. Take a spoon from the drawer. Stir the tea with the spoon. Put the spoon in the sink. Pick up the glass from the shelf. Fill the glass with water from the tap. Lift the glass to the mouth. Drink the water. Place the glass on the counter. Pick up the plate with the toast. Carry the plate and the cup to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up a slice of toast. Take a bite. Chew and swallow. Take another bite. Pick up the cup. Sip the tea. Place the cup on the table. Finish the toast. Pick up the plate. Stand up. Carry the plate and the cup to the sink. Place them in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing work bag, checking phone for today's program schedule and heatwave alerts
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bedroom. Open the wardrobe door. Take the work bag off the hook. Place the bag on the bed. Open the bag zipper. Pick up the notebook from the desk. Put the notebook into the bag. Pick up the pen from the desk. Put the pen into the bag. Pick up the water bottle. Put the water bottle into the side pocket. Zip the bag closed. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Press the power button. Swipe the screen to unlock. Tap the calendar app. Scroll down the program schedule. Tap the messages app. Read the heatwave alert message. Tap the reply field. Type a reply message. Press send. Press the power button to lock the phone. Put the phone into the trouser pocket. Pick up the bag with the right hand. Walk out of the bedroom. Press the light switch off.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit office in the morning heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the apartment door. Pull the door closed. Lock the door with the key. Put the key into the bag pocket. Walk down the stairs. Push the building entrance door open. Walk along the sidewalk to the bus stop. Stop at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Tap the transit app. Check the bus arrival time. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Take the transit card out of the bag. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Grasp the overhead handrail with the right hand. Stand and hold the handrail. Shift the bag strap on the shoulder. Look at the stop display. Release the handrail. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Walk two blocks along the sidewalk. Stop at the crosswalk. Wait for the signal. Cross the street. Walk to the office building entrance. Push the glass door open. Walk into the lobby.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community program logistics, emails, phone calls and partner meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the desk. Place the bag on the floor beside the chair. Sit down on the chair. Press the computer power button. Type the login password on the keyboard. Open the email client. Click the inbox. Open the first email. Read the email. Click reply. Type a reply on the keyboard. Click send. Open the second email. Read the email. Click the attachment. Open the spreadsheet. Type the program dates into the cells. Save the file. Pick up the desk phone handset. Dial the partner number. Speak into the handset: "We need to confirm the session time and the volunteer count." Write notes on the notepad with the pen. Hang up the handset. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Pick up the printed sheets. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Staple the sheets. Place the sheets in a folder. Stand up. Walk to the meeting room. Sit down at the table. Open the laptop. Present the program schedule to the partner. Turn the pages of the folder. Point at the timeline on the screen. Answer the partner's questions. Close the laptop. Stand up. Shake hands with the partner. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Open the email client again. Delete the spam messages. Type the meeting notes into a document. Save the document.

enriched_activities.activity: Lunch break, eating at a nearby cafe and resting in the shade
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Push the chair in. Walk out of the office. Push the glass door open. Walk along the sidewalk to the cafe. Push the cafe door open. Walk to the counter. Read the menu board. Speak to the staff: "One sandwich and one iced water, please." Tap the card on the payment reader. Take the receipt. Walk to the table. Sit down on the chair. Unwrap the sandwich. Pick up the sandwich. Take a bite. Chew and swallow. Pick up the glass. Drink the water. Place the glass on the table. Finish the sandwich. Wipe the mouth with the napkin. Place the napkin on the plate. Pick up the tray. Stand up. Carry the tray to the return station. Place the tray on the rack. Walk out of the cafe. Walk to the building entrance. Push the glass door open. Walk to the desk. Sit down on the chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the office: preparing session materials, updating the program schedule and briefing volunteers remotely
enriched_activities.desc: Press the computer power button. Type the login password. Open the document template. Type the session headings on the keyboard. Insert the participant table. Type the participant names into the rows. Save the file. Click print. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Pick up the printed copies. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Count the copies. Place the copies in the folder. Open the spreadsheet with the program schedule. Update the session times in the cells. Save the file. Open the video call app. Click the meeting link. Put on the headset. Speak into the microphone: "Here are the updated session times and the room assignments." Share the screen. Scroll the schedule for the volunteers. Answer the volunteers' questions. Say: "Please arrive thirty minutes early." Click end meeting. Take off the headset. Pick up the phone. Tap the messages app. Type a message to the volunteers. Press send. Put the phone on the desk. Type the supply order list on the keyboard. Send the order email. Close the email client. Stand up. Walk to the filing cabinet. Open the drawer. Place the folder inside. Close the drawer. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Save the open documents. Shut down the computer. Stand up. Pick up the bag from the floor.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the office on a hot afternoon
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the office. Push the glass door open. Walk along the sidewalk to the bus stop. Stop at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Tap the transit app. Check the bus arrival time. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Take the transit card out of the bag. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Grasp the overhead handrail with the left hand. Stand and hold the handrail. Shift the bag on the shoulder. Wipe the forehead with the back of the hand. Look at the stop display. Release the handrail. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Walk two blocks along the sidewalk. Stop at the crosswalk. Wait for the signal. Cross the street. Walk to the building entrance. Push the entrance door open. Walk up the stairs. Walk to the apartment door. Take the key out of the bag pocket. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the door open. Walk inside.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooling off with a cool shower and changing into light home clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Press the light switch on. Pull the shirt over the head. Unfasten the trousers. Pull the trousers off. Place the clothes in the laundry basket. Turn the shower tap handle to the cold side. Step under the shower water. Wet the hair. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Open the cap. Pour shampoo into the palm. Close the cap. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the arms. Rub the soap over the chest. Rinse the body under the water. Turn the tap handle to close the water. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel from the rack. Rub the hair with the towel. Wipe the arms and legs with the towel. Hang the towel on the rack. Take the home clothes from the hook. Pull the shirt over the head. Pull the shorts on. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple dinner with the induction cooker and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the kitchen. Press the light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take the vegetables out. Take the eggs out. Close the refrigerator door. Place the food on the counter. Open the drawer. Take out a knife and a cutting board. Place the cutting board on the counter. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Place the pieces in a bowl. Put the knife down. Take the pot from the cupboard. Fill the pot with water from the tap. Place the pot on the induction cooker. Press the power button on the induction cooker. Press the heat-up button. Open the fridge door. Take the noodles out. Close the fridge door. Put the noodles into the pot. Stir the pot with a spoon. Crack the eggs into the pot. Add the vegetables. Press the induction cooker to lower the heat. Take the bowl from the cupboard. Pour the noodles into the bowl. Press the induction cooker power button off. Carry the bowl to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the chopsticks. Pick up the noodles with the chopsticks. Eat the noodles. Drink the soup from the bowl. Finish the meal. Place the chopsticks on the bowl. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table, washing dishes and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Carry the bowl and the chopsticks to the sink. Place them in the sink. Pick up the cloth from the counter. Wipe the table surface with the cloth. Fold the cloth. Place the cloth on the counter. Pick up the pot from the induction cooker. Carry the pot to the sink. Place the pot in the sink. Turn the tap on. Rinse the bowl under the water. Pick up the sponge. Squeeze dish soap onto the sponge. Scrub the bowl with the sponge. Scrub the chopsticks with the sponge. Rinse the bowl under the water. Turn the tap off. Open the dishwasher door. Pull the lower rack out. Place the bowl on the rack. Place the chopsticks in the basket. Place the pot on the rack. Push the rack in. Close the dishwasher door. Press the dishwasher start button. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the counter with the cloth. Wipe the induction cooker surface with the cloth. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in front of the TV with the air conditioner on, drinking water and scrolling the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the air conditioner remote from the table. Point the remote at the air conditioner. Press the power button. Press the temperature down button. Place the remote on the table. Pick up the TV remote. Press the power button. Press the channel button. Place the TV remote on the table. Lean back on the sofa. Pick up the glass from the table. Lift the glass to the mouth. Drink the water. Place the glass on the table. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Press the power button. Swipe the screen to unlock. Open the social media app. Scroll the feed with the thumb. Tap a video. Watch the video. Tap the like button. Scroll the feed again. Tap the news app. Read the headlines. Tap the close button. Press the power button to lock the phone. Place the phone on the table. Pick up the TV remote. Press the volume up button. Place the TV remote on the table. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take the water bottle out. Close the refrigerator door. Walk back to the living room. Fill the glass from the bottle. Place the bottle on the table. Sit down on the sofa. Drink the water. Pick up the phone again. Press the power button. Scroll the feed. Press the power button to lock the phone. Pick up the TV remote. Press the power button to turn the TV off. Stand up. Pick up the air conditioner remote. Press the power button off. Place the remote on the table. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash-up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Press the light switch on. Turn the tap handle on. Cup the hands under the water. Rub the face with both hands. Turn the tap handle off. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel on the rack. Pick up the toothbrush from the holder. Turn the tap on. Wet the toothbrush. Turn the tap off. Open the toothpaste cap. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Close the cap. Brush the teeth up and down. Spit into the sink. Turn the tap on. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Turn the tap off. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Going to bed early with the fan on, sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Press the fan switch on. Set the fan to medium speed. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Place the phone on the nightstand. Pull the sheet back. Sit down on the bed. Lie down on the bed. Pull the sheet up over the legs. Pull the sheet up to the chest. Turn the head to the right side. Pull the pillow under the head. Turn the body onto the right side. Bend the knees. Stretch the left arm out. Remain lying on the bed without moving. Turn the body onto the left side. Pull the sheet to the shoulders. Remain lying on the bed without moving until morning.
